items.next_required_action: Obtain a versioned accountable product/legal/payment/release decision, then align actual client and server/ledger behavior. Preserve historical records.

items.title: Public publishing integration
items.evidence: Same-origin operator UI, inspection/recovery reads, scoped candidate index, safe operation persistence, explicit confirmation and read-only recovery are implemented. Source/API tests pass; browser navigation is blocked by administrator policy. UI/API/publisher flags remain false.
items.next_required_action: Install all source edits, verify in an allowed browser environment and real Cloudflare staging, configure direct Access-protected same-origin ingress and real grants. Integrate a reviewed link into the existing Next admin PWA only after domain and authorization approval.

items.title: Migration object disposition decisions
items.evidence: The saved-inventory register contains 1,960 catalog entries; all require approved disposition evidence. It is not a list of objects already migrated.
items.next_required_action: Review every object, resolve overloaded RPC behavior and dependencies, compare the 18 recovered deployed functions, and approve migrate/replace/archive/retire decisions with contracts.

items.title: Identity/session and authorization migration
items.evidence: Disabled additive Worker/D1 source implements reviewed imported verified-phone identities, source UUID preservation, verifier-bound code consumption, rotating sessions, same-request recovery, revocation, club-bound identity and offline disabled import planning. 145 new tests pass against synthetic identities and local SQLite. No actual provider adapter, identity import or auth cutover occurred.
items.next_required_action: Implement actual approved WhatsApp/SMS delivery, anonymous/new-user/linking, phone-change/recovery, profile/bootstrap, deletion/privacy operations, full staff roles and native secure storage/single-flight; verify imported bindings and real Cloudflare runtime before client cutover.

items.title: Transactional domains on real D1
items.evidence: No payment, membership, contribution, stock, ticket or approved FET transaction domain was ported to a new authoritative backend.
items.next_required_action: Implement atomic command/ledger/outbox boundaries, idempotency, reconciliation, concurrency and injected-failure proofs, then load/cost/capacity tests on real D1.

items.title: Edge Functions, schedules and providers
items.evidence: Catalog mapping is available; production Edge Functions, cron jobs, Queues, notifications, Wallet and other integrations have not been ported. Batch 4 defines a private authentication-code delivery contract and bounded auth-maintenance handler, not a working external provider adapter or a port of the six legacy jobs.
items.next_required_action: Port approved functions and six scheduled jobs with provider authenticity, retries, dead-letter handling and behavior parity. Resolve live-only and local-only entrypoints.

items.title: Complete typed API and client cutover
items.evidence: Feature composition was hardened, but all native/web/admin repositories and direct Supabase callers remain to be migrated. Batch 2 supplies ONLY a public-content operator identity/API subset; supporter identity and complete native/web/admin migration remain unfinished. The operator API now includes typed inspection and recovery methods and OpenAPI 1.1.0; that is not the complete supporter/native/web/admin migration. Batch 4 adds a strictly compiled TypeScript bearer reference adapter for five auth operations. No Dart/Flutter, Next.js, browser-cookie or original Supabase auth caller was switched.
items.next_required_action: Implement versioned contracts and typed adapters, preserve deep-link/server enforcement and old-client compatibility/minimum versions, and trace all remaining runtime dependencies.

items.title: Final consistent backup and eight AFRICLUB originals
items.evidence: Dated records report a restored but not final-consistent archive and eight inaccessible AFRICLUB originals. The separate 11 public-source originals are not those eight. No live auth-user export or public-content replay was performed in batch 4.
items.next_required_action: Revalidate source access, recover all originals with hashes, take a consistent final database/auth snapshot, and prove restore and complete reconciliation. No billing setting was changed.

items.title: Whole-repository dead code and dependency pruning
items.evidence: Five supported shells were retained; focused source boundaries were strengthened. No full-tree unused-dependency audit, unrelated scaffold deletion or prior revised-copy cleanup was performed.
items.next_required_action: Use complete caller/import/build/test evidence to remove only proven retired code. Preserve opponent data, fixture venues, active predictions, backend ingestion and retention evidence.

items.title: Design and CSS acceptance
items.evidence: Authority wording and five-club scope were corrected. Nine adjacent duplicate CSS rules were merged with ordered AST equivalence; no visual approval was granted. New operator UI uses the existing token bytes; only source/semantic checks passed. No rendered/fidelity/accessibility approval was obtained.
items.next_required_action: Run pinned web build/budgets and responsive/accessibility/browser/native visual reviews against the actual private design references. Review broader semantic-component duplication separately.

items.title: Production cutover
items.evidence: The 18-gate candidate/evidence validator is implemented and tested. No production writer or client was switched. No operator UI or gateway production route was enabled. New supporter authentication templates also remain disabled with a placeholder isolated database ID.
items.next_required_action: Satisfy and verify all gates, freeze/drain writes, reconcile final deltas, approve the candidate, and perform monitored one-writer cutover.

items.title: Supabase retirement
items.evidence: The 22-gate retirement validator is implemented and tested. No keys, jobs, data or services were revoked/deleted/retired.
items.next_required_action: After approved observation, prove no runtime dependency, retained/restorable archives and reconciliation before governed shutdown. After target financial writes, use forward recovery rather than an unreconciled traffic rollback.
